name: groundwork

interface.shortDescription: Set up how a repository works, then run it
interface.longDescription: Onboarding asks how this repository should work — tracker, workflow, branches, verification, architecture, review — as bundles with a recommended choice each time, and writes GROUNDWORK.md. The workflow, review, and QA skills then read that file in every repository.
defaultPrompt: Use groundwork onboarding to set up this repository.

description: Set up how a repository works once, then run planning, step loops, review, and QA from GROUNDWORK.md.
